Home screen, Activated, AFC 4/4, persist. Byte-matched to qemu-ios ipod2g_device.py: nor.bin, gid-blobs.bin, identity.json identical; the system volumes list the same 10801 entries with equal contents except the SpringBoard job plist (same content, different binary-plist encoding) and lockdownd (same patched code; the signature blob differs, ldid vs FirmwareKit). (2) 2.x's AppleD1759PMU-36.2 halt, tethered, prints "pmu waiting for stdby" and sleeps on the PMU interrupt until the cable comes out (EVENT_A bit 3 -> 0x0a bit 0), where 3.x/4.x's -94.7 writes 0x6f=0x90; the gesture now unplugs once the guest has turned the backlight rail off.
